title: Perfume as a bag charm
what: Small bottles designed to hang from a bag, so the scent is carried and seen like an accessory.
note: CYKLAR sells a silicone sleeve for its oil cap; WHIPPED and Milky Mane sell keyring and 20 ml bag sizes. Le Falcone's Bonita bottles go further: the bottle itself is shaped like a small handbag.
forApps: Clay: show 'carry' sizes; Safe Batch: roller and mini formats for DIY oils.

title: Hair perfumes that also care
what: Light, low-alcohol mists for hair, often with keratin or oils for shine.
note: WHIPPED Peach Pear adds low-molecule keratin; Tamburins has a hair perfume line.
forApps: Clay: a hair-scent step in the routine; layering with body scents.

title: Budget twins of luxury perfumes
what: Creators pair cheap mists or Gulf brands with the luxury perfumes they resemble.
note: See the budget twins list. These are opinions, so smell before buying.
forApps: Clay: 'expensive vs just as good' comparisons.

title: Sample cards and tiny jars
what: Small makers send tiny sample jars or vials attached to a printed card that doubles as a business card or gift.
note: Many indies include a matching sample with each bottle so you can test before opening the full size. Brands are also selling 7 ml minis in gift tins (Dime Beauty's Stay Awhile, a toasted-pistachio gourmand, is one).
forApps: Safe Batch: sample sizes for testing new DIY blends; Clay: a 'samples to try' shelf.

title: Layering sets
what: Brands design scents to be worn on top of each other and sell them in numbered or paired sets.
note: KAYALI numbers each scent; CYKLAR and Michael Malul sell layering sets; Tamburins sells balms to wear under spray.
